mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% coincident with a housing starts (HOUST) drop of more than 10% in the same month indicates weakening consumer demand and construction activity, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY < -2% AND HOUST < previous month - 10%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the cumulative return is not significantly below the median baseline at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.3 percentage points for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which historically precede negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings pressure.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower during triggered periods compared to non-triggered periods at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of 1% or more, sustained for two consecutive months, indicates contraction in manufacturing activity, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate revenue outlooks deteriorate.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous month - 1% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered episodes at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp one-month increase in the federal funds rate of more than 0.75 percentage points, in conjunction with a concurrent rise in CPIAUCSL of at least 0.4%, signals aggressive monetary tightening amid rising inflation, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened rate and inflation risk.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS change > 0.75% AND CPIAUCSL change > 0.4% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in these episodes at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) increase below 50,000 persons for three consecutive months, despite a concurrent unemployment rate below 4%, signals hidden labor market slack and underemployment, which precedes muted S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to weak earnings growth.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS change < 50,000 for 3 consecutive months AND UNRATE < 4%
regime_hint: tight labor market with weak payroll growth
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly different from baseline median during triggered periods at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in real retail sales (RSAFS) of more than 2% for four consecutive months signals a persistent contraction in consumer demand, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to expected earnings compression.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower during triggered episodes at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly rise of at least 1% in both the industrial production index (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals an expansion in manufacturing and construction activity, which historically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to improved corporate earnings expectations.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO change > 1% AND HOUST change > 1% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during triggered episodes at 5% significance.
